materials.prompt: Create one original 1024x1024 opaque material study board for Gloamthread: Two Ends, a side-view pixel action adventure set in a hand-built lantern loom ruin. No reference images, recognizable game art, text, labels, symbols, frames, borders, grid lines, characters, lighting effects, shadows cast across panels, perspective or transparent pixels. Fill the canvas with exactly four equal columns and two equal rows: eight 256x512 rectangular swatches, four columns by two rows; each panel is256wide and512high. Panel boundaries are x=0,256,512,768,1024 and y=0,512,1024. Top row y0..511: ember worn stone, ember aged brass, ember woven roots, ember dense cloth. Bottom row y512..1023: moss worn stone, moss aged brass, moss woven roots, moss dense cloth. Every panel must be a fully filled flat-on repeating material without empty margins. Each panel contains small deliberate readable material marks, a quiet dark base and 6-12 related colors. Ember colors: ink navy, muted burnt clay, dark copper, warm slate, restrained honey highlights. Moss colors: ink navy, muted blue green stone, aged teal brass, deep sage roots, restrained pale mint highlights. Stone has irregular fitted chips and stitch-like short incisions; brass has fine offset peening and sparse dark rivet marks; roots form interlocked curved fibrous grain; cloth shows a coarse diagonal cross weave. Use coherent clusters and restrained contrast, no random colored noise, no large objects. Design marks to remain readable when each panel is reduced to a16x16pixel texture. The local converter will use these only inside existing terrain shapes: physical edges, transparent masks, hazards, bridges and traversal cues stay authored in the game. This is original material source, not a finished tileset.
